title: Sound
info: Sound is made when something vibrates, moving back and forth quickly.
Sound travels through air, water, and solids. It travels faster in solids than in air.
You hear sound when those vibrations reach your ears.

questions.q: In space, where there is no air, sound
options: Cannot travel to your ears the way it does on Earth
